Stage 1 component distributions. The Synthetic developmental state series experiment uses the
layer1 layer. Facets show components 1-4 in decomposition order; densities summarize
sample-coordinate distributions; rugs mark sample coordinates; dotted vertical lines mark zero;
Density fills and rug colours encode categorical planted_group. The analysis unit is
independent biological observation; the design is cross_sectional; the estimand is the
descriptive distribution of sample coordinates. No component-selection threshold is applied.
This descriptive gallery does not rank or nominate a biological coordinate.
